title: HGM-Dual: Lineage-Aware Guided Agent Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.30042v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Harness optimization, which improves an agent's prompts, tools, and workflows, is an increasingly effective way to enhance agents built on frozen or closed-source LLMs. Leading approaches such as the Darwin--Godel Machine and the Huxley--Godel Machine (HGM) rely on recursive self-improvement and were developed mainly for coding, where the competence needed to improve the agent coincides with the competence being improved. Planning tasks, in which an agent must produce a sequence of tool calls that jointly satisfies interacting constraints, break this alignment. There, open-ended self-modification repeatedly explores ineffective changes and consumes substantial evaluation budgets. translated_title: HGM-Dual：面向长程规划的谱系感知引导式智能体框架优化
translated_abstract: 框架优化通过改进智能体的提示词、工具和工作流，是增强基于冻结或闭源大语言模型构建的智能体的一种日益有效的方法。以达尔文-哥德尔机和赫胥黎-哥德尔机为代表的前沿方法依赖于递归自我改进，且主要针对编程任务开发——在编程任务中，改进智能体所需的能力与被改进的能力恰好一致。而规划任务打破了这种一致性：智能体必须生成一系列共同满足相互制约约束的工具调用。在这种情况下，开放式自我修改会反复探索无效的改动，并消耗大量评估预算。我们提出了HGM-Dual，一个面向规划智能体的诊断引导、预算高效的框架演化方法。首先，HGM-Dual将智能体演化表示为谱系感知的上下文。该上下文记录了每个祖先做了什么改动、哪些行为得到了改进……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了HGM-Dual框架，通过谱系感知上下文和诊断引导，实现面向规划智能体的预算高效框架演化，解决了开放式自我改进在长程规划任务中反复探索无效改动、消耗大量评估预算的问题。
en_tdlr: HGM-Dual introduces a diagnostic-guided framework with lineage-aware context to enable budget-efficient harness evolution for planning agents, addressing the inefficiency of open-ended self-improvement that repeatedly explores ineffective changes in long-horizon planning tasks.
